dataset: Jena climate 2009-2016, TensorFlow official tutorial mirror
head: last recurrent output -> Linear(64,168)
selection: minimum validation MSE, first epoch wins ties
test_policy: Evaluate all frozen runs after all scheduled training; do not tune on test
notes: Whole windows within chronological 70/20/10 splits. Discard gap-crossing windows. Equal hidden size is not equal parameter count. Overlapping rolling origins are not independent observations.
